testsuite.name: Parwar - AI Assistant, Quizzes, Study Plans & Collaborative Notes (Iterations 3-4)
testsuite.details:
Tester: Parwar
Software under test: UniShare (github.com/Seganation/unishare)
Test basis: UniShare_Iteration_3.md AI Learning Assistant use cases (UC2 Chat with AI Assistant, UC-S3-011..UC-S3-020, Sequences 2-4, Use Case 3 Generate AI Quiz) and UniShare_Iteration_4.md UC-S4-002 Real-Time Collaborative Notes; code: src/server/api/routers/ai.ts, src/server/ai/*, src/app/api/chat, src/app/api/ai/generate-note, src/app/api/notes, src/app/api/liveblocks-auth, src/components/ai/*, src/components/notes/*, src/app/(student)/ai, src/app/(student)/courses/[id]/notes.
Techniques: Equivalence Partitioning (EP), Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Decision Table (DT), State Transition (ST), Use Case / scenario testing (UC), Error Guessing (EG).

Common test data (prisma/seed.ts, every seeded password is admin123)
Student A - Sarah Ahmed (sarah@student.utm.my), APPROVED, course owner
Student B - John Doe (john@student.utm.my), APPROVED, ACCEPTED CONTRIBUTOR on the test course
Student C - David Kim (david@student.utm.my), APPROVED, ACCEPTED VIEWER on the test course
Student D - Michael Chen (michael@student.utm.my), APPROVED, no relation to the test course
Student E - Alice Wong (alice@student.utm.my), role PENDING (not approved)
Course: "SECJ3343 Software Quality Assurance" created by Student A (default cards incl. Notes), description "Testing techniques and quality models".
AI provider: Google Gemini (GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY set, chat badge 'Gemini 2.5 Flash'); Liveblocks configured (LIVEBLOCKS_SECRET_KEY). API calls are made from the browser session of the named user (tRPC /api/trpc/ai.*, REST /api/chat, /api/ai/generate-note, /api/notes, /api/liveblocks-auth).

testsuite.name: TS-P8 Collaborative Notes - Real-Time Editing & Pages
testsuite.details: Two browsers (A and B) on the same course. Techniques: UC, ST (online -> offline -> online), BVA (5/6 others), EG.

testcase.name: Two students edit the same page in real time
testcase.summary:
Two students edit the same page in real time.

Test design technique: Use case (UC-S4-002 steps 10-27)

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-04, REQ-P-NOTE-05
testcase.preconditions: Student A (Chrome) and Student B (Firefox, CONTRIBUTOR) both on page 'Getting Started'.

step.expectedresults: B sees the text appear without reloading.

step.actions: B clicks below and types 'Key Concepts:' and a bullet list.
step.expectedresults: A sees B's text; both documents identical.

step.actions: Look at the Active Collaborators bar in both browsers.
step.expectedresults: Each shows own avatar ('<name> (You)') and the other user; '2 online'.

testcase.name: Simultaneous edit of the same text converges
testcase.summary:
Simultaneous edit of the same text converges.

Test design technique: EG (concurrency), Iteration 4 A2

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-04
testcase.preconditions: A and B on the same page containing the word 'Testing'.

step.actions: At the same time A types 'Unit ' before and B types ' Basics' after 'Testing'.
step.expectedresults: Both editors end with the same text (e.g. 'Unit Testing Basics'); no error, no lost characters.

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-05
testcase.preconditions: Student A on a page; 6 other course members available (owner/collaborator accounts).

step.expectedresults: B's avatar removed from A's bar; count decreases by 1.

testcase.summary:

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-06
testcase.preconditions: Student A on SECJ3343 notes with page 'Getting Started'; Student B on the same course.

step.actions: A changes the title to 'Week 1 Notes' and presses Enter.
A opens the menu of 'Week 1 Notes' and clicks 'Add sub-page'.
A types in the sub-page while B stays on 'Getting Started'.

testcase.name: Delete a page with sub-pages
testcase.summary:
Delete a page with sub-pages.

Test design technique: ST (page -> deleted with children), DT (OK / Cancel)

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-07
testcase.preconditions: Student B (CONTRIBUTOR) on 'Week 1 Notes' which has one sub-page; 'Getting Started' is first page.

step.actions: Delete 'Week 1 Notes' and Cancel 'Are you sure you want to delete this page?'

step.expectedresults: 'Week 1 Notes' and its sub-page removed; 'Getting Started' opens.

requirement.title: Delete pages and server-side permission checks

testcase.name: Offline edits sync after reconnect
testcase.summary:
Offline edits sync after reconnect.

Test design technique: ST (online -> offline -> online), Iteration 4 A1

Requirements: REQ-P-NOTE-08, REQ-P-NOTE-04
testcase.preconditions: A and B on the same page.

step.actions: B goes offline (DevTools > Network > Offline) and types 'offline line'.
step.expectedresults: B can keep typing; A does not see it yet.
Both see 'offline line' and 'online line'; documents identical.
